decisions.decision: Refused to run `--check` and `--write` on a CBOR log
decisions.rationale: A CBOR log is canonical by construction, so there is nothing for `--check` to compare and `--write` would silently convert a binary store to text.
decisions.quote: A CBOR log is canonical by construction, so there is nothing for `--check` to compare and `--write` would silently convert a binary store to text.

decisions.decision: Turned parse warnings into failing exit codes under `--strict`
decisions.rationale: Under `--strict` a document that parses with warnings still fails, because a gate asked to be told about them.
decisions.quote: Under `--strict` a document that parses with warnings still fails, because a gate asked to be told about them.

decisions.decision: Checked for comments in documents
decisions.rationale: Comments are not part of any record, so canonical form cannot reproduce them. The manual recommends `fmt --write` as a pre-commit habit, which makes silent deletion of a reviewer's notes the difference between a formatter and a hazard.
decisions.quote: Comments are not part of any record, so canonical form cannot reproduce them.

decisions.decision: Refused multiple documents with `--output`
decisions.rationale: `--output` names one destination, so it takes one document. Two would silently overwrite each other, leaving whichever came last.
decisions.quote: `--output` names one destination, so it takes one document.

decisions.decision: Distinguished formatted files from unformatted ones with `--check`
decisions.rationale: `--check` reports whether the file is already canonical, and says which file is not.
decisions.quote: `--check` reports whether the file is already canonical, and says which file is not.

decisions.decision: Rewrote files in place with `--write`, leaving stdin alone
decisions.rationale: `--write` rewrites the file in place — unless the input was stdin, which has no file to rewrite and whose path is the literal `-`.
decisions.quote: `--write` rewrites the file in place — unless the input was stdin, which has no file to rewrite and whose path is the literal `-`.

decisions.decision: Kept the round-trip guard that checks for moved records or labels
decisions.rationale: The round-trip guard fires only when the writer produces something the parser reads back differently, which is a defect in `write_surface`, not an input a user can supply. No document reaches it, so no test can distinguish a guard that checks from one that does not.
decisions.quote: The round-trip guard fires only when the writer produces something the parser reads back differently, which is a defect in `write_surface`, not an input a user can supply.

decisions.decision: Ensured tests do not depend on the state of the tree
decisions.rationale: Every test that needs a document with a *property* — not canonical, has comments — builds it here rather than relying on a repository fixture having that property.
decisions.quote: A shared path under `TMPDIR` failed in CI once already, in a test added in 0.13: it wrote into a fixed directory and depended on the state of the machine rather than on the code.

decisions.decision: Removed tests for cmd_providers and cmd_merge
decisions.rationale: cmd_providers and cmd_merge are untouched at 12 and 11, which is what a correct measurement of this change looks like.
decisions.quote: cmd_providers and cmd_merge are untouched at 12 and 11

decisions.decision: Ensured every test writes the document whose property it needs
decisions.rationale: Every test here now writes the document whose property it needs.
decisions.quote: Every test here now writes the document whose property it needs.
